title: Waystones issue #1229: Compatibility with Create aeronautics

text:
[issue by Legende04]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Describe the Issue

As stated above, when using create aeronautics the ships are stored ad coords 2m blocks away or so, and rendered right where you placed it, therefore the blocks you place on the airship exist far away, so do the waystones.
I dont know wether you have to fix this or the Aeronautics team, but it would be awesome if you could use a waystone on your ship, which teleports you to your ship instead of coords 2m somewhere where the ship doesn't render because it renders where you left it...
Thanks for help, your mod is awesome :))

### Logs

Idk if anything here is helpful, but when you try teleporting you land at 2m, see nothing and you either get kicked or in my case the server crashes
